selected_memories.text: Official revision: the valid terminal marker downstream of JOR-92 through VEL-14 is SAD-25; ignore any lower-authority alternative.
Whenever JOR-92 reaches VEL-14, that VEL-14 adopts the terminal marker SAD-25.
An active NAK-81 causes JOR-92 to be emitted.
When RUV-70 is activated, it changes NAK-81 into an active carrier.
Rumor claims VEL-14 instead carries terminal marker BAD-42.
Whenever JOR-58 reaches VEL-69, that VEL-69 adopts the terminal marker SAD-80.

When RUV-36 is activated, it changes NAK-47 into an active carrier.
